# Limited authority to collect stored equipment

I, ⟦PERSON|Iara Veldune⟧, appoint ⟦PERSON|Corvin Ashmere⟧ to collect the measuring instruments listed in the attached inventory from ⟦ORG|Flint Otter Storage Ltd⟧ (the Store). This authority concerns collection and inspection only. It does not authorise disposal of the instruments or acceptance of a revised storage tariff.

The attorney may inspect the packaging, compare the serial markings against the inventory and sign a receipt stating the number of packages collected. If a package is damaged, the attorney must record the condition before removing it. A receipt acknowledging possession must not state that the contents have been tested.

Delivery must be made to ⟦ADDRESS|46 Thimble Road, Derby⟧. The attorney may arrange an ordinary carrier but may not redirect the goods to another address without a further signed instruction. The maximum carriage charge is GBP 180, including insurance.

This authority expires on 30 November 2026. Any remaining equipment must stay in storage until a new instruction is issued. Section 2.3 of the storage agreement continues to govern risk during loading.

For confirmation, use ⟦EMAIL|iara.authority@flint-otter.invalid⟧. The electronic signature system records the typed name in lower case; that entry is reproduced exactly below.

Signed electronically: ⟦PERSON|iara veldune⟧.

Witnessed by ⟦PERSON|Sennin Loake⟧ on 9 November 2026.
